name: table-3d-model-picker-compact
title: Compact the table 3D model picker
description: Reduce catalog row height and improve scroll alignment without changing model selection behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Implemented a desktop-only compact catalog contract in the existing final stylesheet: controls are slightly shorter, rows are 62px with 48px thumbnails, names use one-line ellipsis, capacity and badges share one metadata row, and proximity scroll snap reduces partially clipped rows. Mobile carousel dimensions and all selection/filter/viewer/AR/apply callbacks remain unchanged. No CI, component test, production build, browser viewport check, or physical-phone validation was run through the GitHub connector.
